func ScrollAreaExample() *native.Node {
	scrollArea1 := ui.NewScrollArea(ui.ScrollAreaRootProps{ViewportSize: func() ui.Extent {
		return ui.Extent{Width: 320, Height: 160}
	}, ContentSize: func() ui.Extent {
		return ui.Extent{Width: 320, Height: 880}
	}})
	return scrollArea1.Root().Children(func() *native.Node {
		var children []*native.Node
		state := ui.UseScrollAreaState()
		children = append(children, scrollArea1.Viewport(ui.PartProps{Style: ui.Style().Width(320).Height(160).Overflow("hidden")}).Children(func() *native.Node {
			return scrollArea1.Content(ui.PartProps{Style: func() ui.StyleBuilder {
				return ui.Style().Transform(fmt.Sprintf("translateY(%gpx)", -state().Offset.Y))
			}}).Children(func() *native.Node {
				var children []*native.Node
				for index := range 40 {
					children = append(children, ui.Text("Row ", index).Height(22).Node)
				}
				return ui.Fragment(children)
			}).NativeNode()
		}).NativeNode())
		children = append(children, scrollArea1.Scrollbar(ui.ScrollAreaScrollbarProps{Orientation: "vertical"}).Children(func() *native.Node {
			return scrollArea1.Thumb(ui.ScrollAreaThumbProps{Orientation: "vertical"}).NativeNode()
		}).NativeNode())
		return ui.Fragment(children)
	}).NativeNode()
}

		return ui.Fragment(children)

	email, setEmail := ui.CreateSignal("")
	field1 := ui.NewField(ui.FieldRootProps{Required: true, Filled: func() bool {
		return email() != ""
	}})

		return ui.Fragment([]*native.Node{field1.Label(ui.FieldLabelProps{}).Children("Email").NativeNode(), field1.Control(ui.FieldControlProps{InputPartProps: ui.InputPartProps{Value: email, Placeholder: "you@example.com", OnInput: func(event *native.Event) {
			setEmail(event.Value)
		}}}).NativeNode(), field1.Description(ui.PartProps{}).Children("Used for receipts").NativeNode(), field1.Error(ui.PartProps{}).Children("Enter a valid email address").NativeNode()})
	}).NativeNode()
}

go/radio-group.html:
func RadioGroupExample() *native.Node {
	value, setValue := ui.CreateSignal("system")
	radioGroup1 := ui.NewRadioGroup(ui.RadioGroupProps{Value: func() *string {
		current := value()
		return &current
	}, OnValueChange: func(next string, _ *native.Event) {
		setValue(next)
	}})
	return radioGroup1.Root().Children(func() *native.Node {
		var children []*native.Node
		for _, option := range []string{"light", "dark", "system"} {
			children = append(children, func() *native.Node {
				radio2 := ui.NewRadio(ui.RadioProps{Value: option})
				return radio2.Root().Children(func() *native.Node {
					return ui.Fragment([]*native.Node{radio2.Indicator(ui.PartProps{}).NativeNode(), ui.Text(option).Node})
				}).NativeNode()
			}())
		}
		return ui.Fragment(children)
	}).NativeNode()
}
